_comment: The canonical human Skeleton asset (docs/CHARACTERS.md). Bones come from 'source' (baked to assets/skeletons/human.skel by tools/bake_skeleton, or through assets/cache). Sockets: named transforms on bones (space 'bind' = model-space offset at the bind pose, 'bone' = bone local). Virtual bones: a bone parented to 'source' that follows 'target' (IK targets; never in clips or on the wire). Groups extend / replace the built-ins (all, upper_body, lower_body, spine, head, arms, arm_l, arm_r, hands, fingers, legs, feet, hair, face). base_pose: retarget base pose rotation offsets (deg) from the bind.

groups._parts: Disjoint regions that tile the body, for cutting a full-body mesh into modular parts ('region' in a character part).
